properties.description: Standard top bar with triggers opening a full-width multi-column panel — icon·title·description per item, grouped under headers, optional promoted feature card, scrim dims page. Vercel/Figma/Notion style.
properties.use_case: Brand with many destinations needing grouping + explanation (platform with 6+ products, docs/resources hubs)
properties.anti_pattern: More than ~4 columns; panel taller than ~60vh; hover-only open with no close-grace timer
